title: What Scripture Actually Says About Your Phone at the Dinner Table
caption:
Face down isn't the same as put away.

Part of you is still tracking who's texting while you sit at the table telling yourself you're present. Scripture never mentions a phone, but it names exactly what this is: you cannot serve two masters. Whoever gets your full attention is who you're actually serving in that moment.

The people across the table aren't reading your screen time. They're reading whether you looked up.
